#### What's great

I'm a paying Pro user. The core reason I subscribed — transcribing from a URL — has been broken on my account since July 28, 2026.

One public YouTube link, pasted by hand into their "Transcribe file on the Internet" form, gets created, sits for 10–20 minutes at zero duration and zero file size, then fails with status 400 and errCode 10011, "online link lambda time out". A public Vimeo link fails the same way with errCode 10010. Local file upload still works fine, so it's their link download step.  
  
Credit where it's due: the transcription itself is good. Accuracy holds up on accented and multilingual audio, speaker ID works, the editor is quick, and export covers TXT, DOCX and SRT. That's why I paid. [...] #### What needs improvement

The biggest thing I'm missing is bulk uploading. When I have many recordings, uploading files one by one becomes unnecessarily time-consuming, so proper batch upload would make a big difference.

And, of course, I wouldn't complain about a slightly lower price 😄 But overall, these are relatively small issues — the service itself is very solid and I genuinely like using it.

#### vs Alternatives

I've tried a few other transcription tools, but I kept using Clipto because it feels straightforward and dependable. I don't need a complicated workflow — I mainly want good transcription, a clean interface, and something that works consistently. Clipto does that very well.

Clipto is designed for local media workflows. AI tools can ask Clipto for moments and context, but they do not get open-ended access to your Mac

### Local-first by default

Clipto indexes and searches your media locally. Your source files are not uploaded by default.

### Approved folders only

Choose the folders Clipto can search. AI tools only receive the structured results Clipto returns.

### Disconnect anytime

Remove access for Codex, Claude, ChatGPT, or any connected client from Clipto's Connected AI Tools page.

### Every result is verifiable

Each moment includes a timestamp, evidence, and an Open in Clipto link back to the original media.
